## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe your use case for this feature:

- Who would benefit from this feature?
- How would it be used?
- What workflows would it improve?

## Integration Impact

Does this feature relate to any existing modules or integrations?

- [ ] Core ledger functionality
- [ ] CLI commands
- [ ] Heuristics/scoring
- [ ] IntentLog integration
- [ ] Boundary Daemon integration
- [ ] Privacy/encryption
- [ ] NatLangChain export
- [ ] Other: ___

## Implementation Suggestions

If you have ideas on how to implement this feature, please share them here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
